description: Show the state of the Auto Apply app on the user's computer: whether it is online, which conversations are running and what each is doing, how many applications are running or queued in one-click apply, whether any employer is waiting for an SMS code, and the latest reply in the Skills conversation (the default target of send_job_apply_instruction). Requires the AceRound Auto Apply desktop app on the user’s computer to be signed in and open (running in the background after closing the window also works); if the app is offline or outdated, the tool says so. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope job_applications:read.)
name: get_job_apply_client_status
